correctness.rationale: At z=-1 any flat energy equals u-2a or a resonator eigenvalue. Cyclicity makes the resonator eigenvalues simple and the root component of each eigenvector nonzero, so none of those eigenvalues survives in a fiber at z different from -1 (the projected lower equation forces backbone amplitude zero and the upper equation kills the resonator component). For nonresonant E the scalar Schur complement is (u-E-2a)+(a-b^2 G(E))|1+z|^2. Hence both coefficients vanish precisely at the proposed tuning. Equivalently the candidate energies are the eigenvalues of K-(b^2/a)ee^T; positivity of the spectral weights makes the interlacing strict, with one energy below the first pole and in each successive internal gap, none above the last. At a tuning, Schur congruence gives inertia equal to that of diag(0,K-E) at every z. There are exactly j-1 negative eigenvalues and one zero for E_j, proving the index and simplicity; continuity on the compact circle gives a global positive gap to all other bands. The eigenvector with backbone component 1 and resonator component -b(1+z)(K-E_j I)^{-1}e has exactly two occupied cells. Its lower block forces any constant-vector Bloch eigenfunction to be zero; its norm is bounded below and above, so translates span the full point eigenspace by Fourier density. The path characteristic and endpoint cofactor recurrences yield the stated Chebyshev equation with the correct sign and factor of c.
residual_risks: Simplicity and gap are for fixed positive hoppings and cyclic root. No parameter-uniform lower gap bound is proved; the recorded finite checker covers paths, not arbitrary resonators.

value.rationale: With resonator and all hoppings frozen, the exact law gives both necessity and a constructive choice of a bottom-to-next-to-top isolated flat band by varying one scalar, including how to read the entire design list from a single finite matrix. The ordered isolation and exact minimal cell support go beyond existence or an ordinary sawtooth example. The interlacing step is textbook; its linkage to the full Bloch tuning and localization problem is the useful structural result.
residual_risks: No bound on usable gap size across designs or robustness to disorder is supplied.
